news.title: Uday Narayan Sharma completed the acquisition of 47.73% stake in Terai Dooars Tea Co. Private Limited from Terai Tea Company Limited (BSE:530533) for INR 17.1 million.
news.body:
Uday Narayan Sharma acquired 47.73% stake in Terai Dooars Tea Co. Private Limited from Terai Tea Company Limited (BSE:530533) for INR 17.1 million on March 30, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 17.06 million will be paid by the buyer. As part of consideration, INR 17.06 million is paid towards common equity of Terai Dooars Tea Co. Private Limited.

The transaction is subject to approval of merger agreement by target board.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹3.28 (vs ₹0.62 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.28 (up from ₹0.62 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹131.3m (down 63% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹22.6m (up 426% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 17% (up from 1.2% in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 13% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 14% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 6.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks.
